articles.headline: No. 8 Arizona tops Colorado State 96-83 with all 5 starters reaching double figures in Maui
articles.description: — Ivan Kharchenkov scored 24 points and Caleb Holt had 20 for No. 8 Arizona in a 96-83 win over Colorado State on the first day of the Maui Invitational on Monday night.

articles.description: — Mekhi Mason scored a career-high 31 points to lead San Jose State to a 88-79 victory over UC San Diego on Monday night in the third-place game of the Acrisure Series.

article.story: ANN ARBOR, Mich. -- — Freshman Quinn Costello had a career-high 16 points and seven teammates also scored in double figures, helping No. 20 Michigan beat William & Mary 123-79 on Sunday. The Wolverines (3-1) tied the fourth-highest scoring game in school history, reaching the highest point total since 1990 against Iowa. The Tribe (2-2) were competitive in the first half, trailing by just five at halftime. Then it fell apart as they allowed the defending national champions to score 75 points in the second half. Roddy Gayle set the tone early for his high-scoring squad. He had a go-ahead, three-point play and a pair of 3-pointers in a 1:33 span early in the game, giving him nine of his 13 points, and Michigan didn’t trail again. Gayle was among the many players across the country who won court orders against the NCAA’s new eligibility rules to play for a fifth season. Moustapha Thiam scored 16, J.P. Estrella had 15 points and Trey McKenney scored 14 for the Wolverines. Taking advantage of playing time in the rout, reserves Kenny Nolan and Oscar Goodman added 11 points apiece. William & Mary, meanwhile, simply could not keep up the pace offensively and struggled at the other end of the court all afternoon. Stas Sivka scored 13 points and Brian Carter had 10 points for a team that made just 38.8% of its shots. The Wolverines have gotten off to a solid start this season despite losing coach Dusty May and three players to the NBA. Estrella and Thiam have made an instant impact as transfers and Costello, a 6-foot-10 forward, is making a smooth transition from high school to college basketball under coach Mike Boynton. Up next William & Mary: Hosts Bowling Green on Tuesday night. Michigan: Plays at Villanova on Saturday night. ------ Sign up for Top 25 poll alerts here, visit the Top 25 here and see AP’s full men’s basketball coverage here
